title: S6 index-table — a dense ruled list where the separators do real work
idea: A dense ruled list — a menu, a schedule, a price list, a directory. Name, detail and value align in three stable columns, and every row carries the same hairline.
why_new: it was, when BIGR-885 was written. It largely is not now: the rule-row item pattern already builds exactly this — name at the start, detail at the end, one hairline per row, for menus, schedules, directories and price lists — inside a centered-stack.
risk: building it as an archetype creates two ways to express one idiom, and the page plan would have to choose between them on every list-like section. My advice is to widen rule-row instead and close S6.
